code: A harmless out-of-bounds read occurs during UCS table building.
note: The reported issue is an out-of-bounds read in the UCS table-building path, so the trace follows attacker-controlled compressed input into the table construction code.
Parsed dynamic Huffman code lengths from the compressed stream are handed to inflate_table() to build the literal/length decode table.
The function assumes lens[] entries are valid bit lengths and uses them as indices while counting code lengths, making malformed input directly influence table-building state.
The sorted symbol list drives decode-entry generation; attacker-influenced lengths determine which symbols are emitted into the table.

The table builder writes decode entries and invalid markers into the output table; the vulnerability hypothesis is that malformed UCS/table-building input can cause an out-of-bounds read during this construction path.
